about: Discover or re-discover, the emblematic block breaker game in a fully modernized version! Classic elements from the franchise will definitely make a comeback, with a brand-new look, new rules, as well as new effects, bonuses and features!
Including, for the very first time, a Battle Royale mode called "Eternal Battle".
Guaranteed to take veteran players by surprise!

Arkanoid is an iconic arcade game, developed by TAITO Corporation in 1986. When the mother ship ARKANOID comes under attack, the small spacecraft VAUS manages to escape but ends up warped into another dimension.
Wandering in an inter-dimensional labyrinth, VAUS must destroy blocks called "spacewalls" in order to defeat "DOH", the creator of the maze responsible for ARKANOID’s destruction.
Arkanoid – Eternal Battle, developed by the talented French studio Pastagames marks the return of the iconic block breaker game.
summary: The Return of the Iconic Block-Breaker!
